data.sub: 15 din mein sarso ke rate 800 rupaye badh gaye.

chat.say: Pakode band, ab sirf ubla khana milega!
Par Mummy tadka tel bina kaise lagega?

data.asar: Sarso tel aur kitchen budget thoda tight hoga.
data.caption:
Kitchen budget par fir se mehngai ka jhatka! 🛢️

• Sarso ki keematon mein pichhle 15 dinon mein bada uchhal aaya hai.
• Sirf do hafton mein rates seedhe ₹800 badh gaye hain.
• Is tezi se kisaano ko to tagda fayda mil raha hai, par kitchen ka tel aur mehnga hone ka dar hai.

Lagta hai ab parathe bhi bina tel ke hi sekhne padenge! 😂

Aapke shehar mein sarso ka tel kitne rupaye litre chal raha hai? Comment mein batao!
